Test 'acceptance: the baseline test fails for the reported reason before any fix and is shown to fail; a test that passes before the fix proves nothing' runs the real runner on the platform's capabilityRouter.ts:26-36 (confirmed on both runs) and on the same lines fixed (passes_before_fix); 9 tests in the file, 203 in the repo (npm test). 16 of 17 mutations fail a test; the 17th is equivalent.
